thread:
katie: @channel :loudspeaker: New Dedicated update: deploying a tiny MI300E edge micro-pool in Milwaukee (MKE) today to support low-latency pilots and internal QA. See the rollout notes below and reservation guidance.

capacity-bot: Automated: pool provisioned -> mke-mi300e-edge-alpha (3x MI300E nodes). Metadata: region=mke, pool_type=edge, gpu=mi300e.

raj: Nice. Whats the warm-up/burst plan?

katie: Warm-up burst window is 09:00-11:00 CDT daily for the next 7 days to populate prefix/KV caches and collect perf traces. After that we'll shift to a 2-hour rotating burst aligned with fairshare.

mike: Ops note  avoid hard pinning to mke-mi300e-edge-alpha for 48h. We may soft-fallback to nearby compatible pools during rebalancing. Also expect slightly higher latencies during initial warming.

ana: Reservation CLI sample:
```
redwood reserve create --pool mke-mi300e-edge-alpha --qty 2 --start 2026-04-20T09:00:00-05:00 --duration 4h --flex
```
Add `--flex` for burst/non-guaranteed reservations.

sanjay: Billing: this pool uses the edge/mi300e pricing tier. For guaranteed committed capacity, open a ticket with capacity@redwood.ai. We can convert short-term reserved buckets if needed.

katie: Docs: https://internal.redwood.ai/docs/dedicated/pools#mke-mi300e-alpha (pool id, SLOs, tagging, and notes). Quick checklist:
- tag routes with region=mke for affinity
- avoid strict model-variant pins for 72h
- enable telemetry flag `redwood.telemetry.edge_sampling=true` to help perf analysis

mike: Security/compliance: standard audit logs enabled. No additional compliance controls for this edge pool; private deployments remain customer-managed for KMS/HSM.

ana: Health-check snippet:
```
# pool status
redwood pool status mke-mi300e-edge-alpha
# sample output:
# state: ready
# nodes: 3
# active_reservations: 0
```

katie: TL;DR: small MI300E edge micro-pool in Milwaukee is live. Warm-up burst 09:00-11:00 CDT daily for 7 days. Follow reservation guidance and tag routes. Ping me or @mike for issues. :rocket: 

capacity-bot: Scheduled summary: utilization report will post tomorrow at 09:05 CDT for the warm-up window.
